name: Trevedra Farm Caravan & Camping Site
confirmedFeatures: Café with takeaway food, shop, showers
overview: A family-run caravan and camping site on the clifftop about a mile from Land's End, close to Sennen. It has its own café serving takeaway food and a Sunday roast, plus a shop. New showers were being built when the site was checked.
surfTripFit: A clifftop pitch close to Sennen keeps a budget surf trip near the area's most consistent waves.
